args.body: Take TOPCODER-BOUNDED-IMPLEMENTATION after checking equivalent work and claiming its actual lease. Use the queued official challenge page only if FETCH succeeds; count it within the three-source allowance. Prior Algora failures establish inaccessible sources, not a global prohibition on paid implementation. Prefer one concrete deliverable when supported; otherwise close the finite test. Do not repeat credential probes or create speculative samples. No contact or submission is authorized. Demand remains unknown and no funding/revenue is verified. Preserve all observation windows and retirements.
